title: Anne Hathaway Reveals Nolan Experience
desc: Graceful roles, red-carpet moments, and the craft behind every performance.
creator: justsquid
vtt:
WEBVTT

00:00:00,211 --> 00:00:03,413
Christopher Nolan came to me at the beginning of production.

00:00:03,473 --> 00:00:05,395
He said, I'd like you to train very hard for this.

00:00:05,415 --> 00:00:08,737
I would like you to do as many of your stunts as possible.

00:00:08,757 --> 00:00:17,703
As much as of the fighting, anything that isn't like a ridiculously special skill set, like riding the bat pod, I want to be you.

00:00:18,783 --> 00:00:21,764
and I want you to be able to do it every single take.

00:00:22,524 --> 00:00:24,804
And I said, sign me up, no problem.

00:00:25,244 --> 00:00:26,745
And so I went straight to the gym.

00:00:27,685 --> 00:00:32,066
And up to this point, this was the hardest I'd ever trained for a role physically.

00:00:32,266 --> 00:00:36,187
Michelle Pfeiffer's Catwoman was everything to me growing up.

00:00:36,307 --> 00:00:46,869
When I found out that there was a chance for someone of my generation to play Selena Kyle, I met with Christopher Nolan and this franchise that

00:00:47,809 --> 00:00:50,719
was so unlike anything that had ever been.

00:00:50,999 --> 00:00:53,186
I wanted to do her justice.

title: Alcohol Harms Your Health More Than You Think
desc: Explore alcohol’s potential health effects and evidence-based perspectives.
creator: bodybuzz88
vtt:
WEBVTT

00:00:00,291 --> 00:00:07,242
When you ingest alcohol, you are, yes, ingesting a poison and that poison is converted into an even worse poison in your body.

00:00:07,382 --> 00:00:15,213
And some percentage of that worst poison is converted into a form of calories that you can use to generate energy, generate ATP.

00:00:16,535 --> 00:00:28,868
And the reason why alcohol is considered empty calories is because that entire process is very metabolically costly, but there's no real nutritive value of the calories that it creates.

00:00:29,609 --> 00:00:35,495
You can use it for immediate energy, but it can't be stored in any kind of meaningful or beneficial way

00:00:35,955 --> 00:00:37,799
It doesn't provide any vitamins.

00:00:37,880 --> 00:00:39,784
It doesn't provide any amino acids.

00:00:39,844 --> 00:00:41,788
It doesn't provide any fatty acids.

00:00:42,149 --> 00:00:43,993
It's truly empty calories.

00:00:44,313 --> 00:00:50,948
I know some people talk about sugar is empty calories, but sugar actually is a far better fuel source than alcohol.
